title: Nice Set!
text: Nice Set!. I've had a tiered tray for almost a year. I change the decor monthly. There are a few months without major holidays that needed a theme, so now August will be Bee themed. The items are a decent quality. You get the gnome, 3 wooden signs and beads or should I say "bee-ds"! I couldn't resist! The wooden signs look mass produced as opposed to homemade. That's not bad, it's just an observation. I will need a few more items for my tray decor, but this will be quite helpful.

product_metadata.title: 5 pcs Honey Bee Gnome Tiered Tray decor (Tray Not Included) - Bumble Bee Gnome Plush, Bee World Day Wooden Sign, Bee Wooden bead garland ,for Spring and Summer kitchen table decor
features: Packing Include -- You will get 3pcs wooden sign includs "Queen bee", "Bee kind" ,"Sweet as Can Bee". 1Pc Wooden Bead Garland, 1Pc lovely Bee Gnome. Please note the Tiered Tray is NOT included.
Handmand --Bumble Bee Gnome is made by professional artisans with great craftsmanship.There is sand at the bottom to make the Honey Bee gnome sit stably.

Premium Material -- These mini wooden signs are made of High quality wooden blocks , clearly and vivid paited . the back is white. and thickness of wooden is 15mm which can support it stands up by itself.
Perfect Spring & Summer Decor --It's excellent decor set for farmhouse tiered tray decor , display shelf , kitchen table and Summer or Spring theme party!
Note -- There are three wooden blocks + one wooden bead garland + one bee Gnome in a box package . The rest accessories showed in picture are only for collocation reference
